conditions: Adult female holotype of Bolitoglossa muisca sp. nov. López-Perilla on 4 February 2021. Value is for the holotype only: the paper prints no eye diameter for any paratype (Table 2, 'Meristic data and measurements of the type series of Bolitoglossa muisca', has no eye diameter row). Unit mm is printed in the quote and in the same sentence (SVL = 61.3 mm, SNL = 3.1 mm) and the 0.1 mm precision statement; the value is printed to 0.01 mm. The sentence is one very long semicolon-joined sentence; the quote keeps its opening words and the clause carrying the eye diameter, with both cuts marked [...]. The eyes are described there as large and 'smaller than interorbital distance' (IOD = 3.37 mm).
